title: Digital Marketing Agency Lahore: Google, Meta Ads | 22 Signals
description: A digital marketing agency Lahore brands use for Google, Meta, TikTok and YouTube ads tracked to WhatsApp chats, bookings and sales. Creative in-house.
eyebrow: Paid Media in Lahore: Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok Ads
h1: The digital marketing agency Lahore brands use when ads have to pay for themselves
intro: We plan, create and run paid campaigns on Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn for established Lahore businesses. Every campaign is tracked past the click to the WhatsApp chat, call, booking or sale it produced, and the ads, videos and landing pages are made by our own team, so you see what each rupee returned.

sections.h: The problem: boosted posts and no idea what worked
p: Plenty of Lahore businesses spend on ads every month without knowing what came back. Posts get boosted from the Instagram app, the audience is "Lahore, 18 to 65", the messages pile up in WhatsApp and nobody records which chats turned into customers. When sales are good the ads get credit; when they dip the ads get cut.
A digital marketing agency Lahore owners can trust should fix the measurement before spending more. Then budget follows results rather than guesses.

sections.h: What our paid media work includes
list: Google Search and Performance Max for people already looking for what you sell.
Meta ads on Facebook and Instagram, including click-to-WhatsApp campaigns, lead forms and catalogue ads.
TikTok and YouTube for reach and video-led launches, with Urdu and English versions where it helps.
LinkedIn for B2B sellers, exporters and software houses targeting foreign buyers.
Creative made in-house: static ads, reels, short videos and motion graphics.
Landing pages built to load quickly on mobile and convert.
Conversion and call tracking, WhatsApp chat attribution and connection to your CRM or sheet.

p: Meta is where most Lahore consumers can be reached at scale, and click-to-WhatsApp ads fit how people here prefer to buy: ask a question, get a price, then decide. TikTok has a very large audience in Pakistan and suits fashion, food and beauty when the creative feels native to the platform. Google Search catches high-intent buyers, for example someone searching for a clinic, a caterer or a property in a specific scheme. LinkedIn is narrower and more expensive per click, and it earns its place mainly for exporters and B2B tech.
We test before committing, keep a small budget aside for new ideas and move money to whatever produces customers at the lowest cost, checked against real sales rather than clicks.

sections.h: Seasons that shape the Lahore ad calendar
list: Ramadan and the run-up to both Eids, when fashion, food and gifting demand rises and ad costs rise with it.
The winter wedding season, the busiest time for bridal wear, salons, caterers, jewellers and venues.
Big online sale events such as 11.11, when shoppers compare prices hard and marketplaces compete for attention.
Admissions periods for schools, colleges and academies.
Project launches for real estate developers, which need a burst of leads and fast follow-up.

sections.h: A Lahore case: Google Ads for a beauty salon
p: For a Lahore beauty salon and studio we run Google Ads alongside a rebuilt website and local SEO. Campaigns are grouped by treatment so each ad leads to the matching page, and calls and booking requests are tracked so we can see which searches bring real appointments. Spend that does not produce bookings gets cut and moved to the treatments that do.

Talk: your margins, best customers and what a lead is worth to you. Plan: channel mix, budget split, tracking set-up and a creative plan, in writing. Build: tracking first, then campaigns, ads and landing pages. Grow: weekly optimisation, monthly reports in rupees and a test plan so the account keeps improving.

sections.h: Ad accounts, payments and platform rules
p: Who owns the Meta and Google ad accounts is agreed in writing at the start, and you always have access to them. That keeps you in control and avoids the common problem of an agency holding the account hostage. We follow Meta's advertising policies closely, because disabled ad accounts are a frequent headache for Pakistani advertisers, and we keep WhatsApp follow-up within Meta's commerce and messaging rules.

We manage campaigns for Lahore brands remotely. Budgets, pacing and the evening peak in ad traffic are watched against agreed limits, and anything unusual is flagged in your shared channel. Weekly check-ins are booked at a time you choose, and your Signal Lead confirms budgets and launch dates in writing.

list: Your monthly ad budget, paid directly to the platforms.
How much creative you need each month, and whether it includes video.

sections.h: Why 22 Signals as your digital marketing agency: Lahore brands get one team
p: Most ad problems are not ad problems. The landing page is slow, the WhatsApp replies take three hours or the creative has run for six months unchanged. Because we build websites, produce video and set up WhatsApp automation in the same team, we can fix the real cause instead of raising the budget.

One Signal Lead owns the whole funnel, from the first ad to the closed sale, and reports on it in plain numbers. Related services: SEO and GEO, video and animation, web development and WhatsApp automation.

faqs.q: What does a digital marketing agency in Lahore do for paid ads?
faqs.a: It plans which platforms to use, sets up tracking, makes the ads, runs and adjusts the campaigns and reports on results. We go further than most by tracking each WhatsApp chat and call back to the ad that started it, and by producing video and landing pages in the same team.

faqs.q: Are Meta ads or Google Ads better for Lahore businesses?
faqs.a: They do different jobs. Google Ads reach people already searching, so they suit clinics, services and urgent needs. Meta ads create demand and suit fashion, food, beauty and launches, especially with click-to-WhatsApp. Most businesses do best with both, weighted by what the tracking shows.

faqs.q: How do you track sales that close on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: We use click-to-WhatsApp ads and tagged links so each chat is linked to its source. Your team marks chats that turn into orders, either in a shared sheet, a CRM or the WhatsApp Business API, and we send that data back to the ad platforms so they find more customers like those.

faqs.q: What budget do we need for ads in Lahore?
faqs.a: It depends on your sector, competition and goals. Clicks and leads in Pakistan usually cost less than in the UK or US, but competitive sectors such as real estate and education still need meaningful budgets. We suggest a test budget, measure cost per lead and customer, then scale what works.

faqs.q: Do you make the ad creative too?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team produces static ads, reels, short videos and motion graphics, in English and Urdu, and changes them often so audiences do not tire of them. Having creative and media in one team means we can make a new version as soon as a test shows what works.

It differs from client to client, so we agree it in writing before launch, including what happens to campaigns, audiences and data if we stop working together. Access is set up through each platform's business manager, so it can be granted or removed in a minute without sharing passwords.

faqs.q: Can you take over campaigns another agency has been running?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with an audit of the existing accounts: tracking, structure, audiences, creative and spend over the last few months. We keep what works, pause what wastes money and rebuild tracking where it is missing. Handover is planned so campaigns keep running while changes are made.
